sloka: अपि चास्या विशालाक्ष्या न किञ्चिदुपलक्षये ।विरूपमपि चाङ्गेषु सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षण् ।। ५.२७.४५।।।।
transliteration: api cāsyā viśālākṣyā na kiñcidupalakṣaye ।virūpamapi cāṅgeṣu susūkṣmamapi lakṣaṇ ।। 5.27.45।।।।

translations.english: "Look at the signs on her body. There is not a little inauspiciousness in the limbs of the largeeyed princess from Mithila.
